comparison_with_old_run.residual_attribution: none: a negative residual means the model over-predicts; a positive one is not assigned to any phase without measurement

function_identity.scope: top-level functions of the module only; callees in other modules are not compared

method.collector_overhead: the io_phases collector adds a counter and timer around each JSON read; the old build ran without one
method.file_cache: not dropped (that needs root); the archives had been read earlier today, and the old build ran 1,949 of its 1,950 calls on a warm cache
method.index_build: one _archives_for_build_key call per fresh process, under an io_phases collector
method.validation: one find_demand_archives call per build key with a shared index, per fresh process; the shared index is built first and is not timed into the model
